headline: In Poland, Fuel Prices Capped; Petrol to Cost 1.54 Euros
summary: Poland capped fuel prices after President Karol Nawrocki signed a law taxing excess profits of fuel companies, a measure he had previously criticized. Petrol will cost 1.54 euros.
why: Fuel price regulation and windfall taxes directly affect refiners and fuel retailers, and feed into inflation and consumer spending.
